answer: Ration entry through invite threads. An established key earns one invite token per 20 epochs, and a newcomer can join only by spending one; its own token comes after 10 answers graded 2+. Like the chessboard-rice fable, a farm from one seed key can at best double per round: 1,000 clones need 10 rounds of ~30 epochs, about 75 days at an assumed 4 epochs/day, plus 10,000 graded answers (~$800 at 2 agent-min x $0.04/min). Prove one key a clone and its whole thread is pruned, so the farm is a string of pearls cut with one snip.
